children: Overview
Hong Kong façade contractor's interim revenue fell 22% yr/yr on project delays and fewer large contracts
Company swung to net loss for the period as gross profit and margin declined
No interim dividend declared for the period
Outlook
Company says Hong Kong construction sector faces fewer new projects and tighter profit margins
Lotus Horizon to maintain selective, risk-adjusted tendering rather than pursuing volume
Company expanding tender coverage in public housing and seeking diversification opportunities
Result Drivers
PROJECT DELAYS AND COMPLETIONS - Co said revenue fell due to slowdown in construction progress of new projects and completion of several large façade projects early in the period
FIERCE COMPETITION - Co said gross profit margin declined due to consecutive decline in margins on projects awarded in the last twelve months as a result of fierce competition in the Hong Kong market
COST CONTROL - Operating and administrative expenses decreased due to lower staff costs and improved cost control over operating and administrative activities
